outlook.statement: The proposed capital reduction will enable the Company to write off accumulated losses and present a true and fair view of the financial position, thereby enabling it to restructure its balance sheet and improve its ability to raise funds and pursue future business opportunities.
The Scheme of Capital reduction is proposed to overcome the hurdle of banking finance and improve the financial position of the Company.

The outlook for the pharmaceutical and chemical industry remains positive. Growth in domestic consumption, export opportunities, government initiatives promoting manufacturing and healthcare infrastructure development are expected to support the industry in the coming years.
